what: When a group enters the band 100px inside the top and bottom of the screen (only after the first scroll has happened), the cells inside float up from 0.5rem below and appear in 1s cubic-bezier(.39,.58,.57,1), each delayed by its assigned order number × .5s — the number is not document order but an order set by the original, like photo 0·text 1~4·video 7, so the large photo settles first, the text one line at a time, and the small video last. Vertical writing one character at a time (.3s stagger, .75s opacity only) uses the same Motion part

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Slot that rises in — data-key is the order number (document order if absent)
options.step: Delay for a single number (seconds), default .5 (original --delay-base 1s × --zoom .5)
options.y: Initial offset from below — rem or px, default 0.5rem. If 0, opacity only
options.margin: Band to subtract from top and bottom of the screen (px), default 100 (original data-expand -100)
options.wait: If scroll, only after the first scroll (default, original is-1st-scrolled), if none, immediately on entry
options.host: css selector — measures entry by this ancestor (attached separately to an inner chunk like vertical-writing text, but so it runs when the whole group enters)
